applicant.name: Stefan Mayr
applicant.organisation: Alpine Credit Bank AG, retail risk analytics

purpose: We want to understand how chronic illness affects our customers' ability to repay, so that we can adjust credit limits and repayment terms for customers with diabetes.
question: How many adults have type 2 diabetes, by age band?
definitions: Adult = aged 18 or older on 31 December 2025.
Type 2 diabetes = any condition with an ICD-10 code starting with E11.
Report per age band: adults with type 2 diabetes.
